schema_version.description: This field identifies the data contract version, not a claim of implementation readiness.

attempt_id.description: This identifier refers to the frozen teacher attempt.

tenant_id.description: This identifier fixes the owning organization for access control.

user_id.description: This identifier refers to the authenticated owner of the attempt.

case_version_id.description: This identifier refers to one immutable case version.

case_sha256.description: This hash identifies the immutable case payload used by the attempt.

answer_text.description: This field contains the exact original teacher answer.

answer_utf8_sha256.description: This hash identifies the original answer bytes in UTF-8.

detection.description: This flag states whether the task requests error detection.

classification.description: This flag states whether the task requests a category for each detected error.

correction.description: This flag or object describes correction requirements or decisions in its parent contract.

explanation.description: This flag or object describes explanation requirements or judgments in its parent contract.

task_components.description: These flags freeze the requested answer components before the attempt.

evaluation_policy_version.description: This field identifies the fixed semantic evaluation policy.

scoring_policy_version.description: This field identifies the exact formula and counting policy.

state.description: This field records the current attempt lifecycle state.

revision.description: This number identifies the current revision for concurrency checks.

submitted_at.description: This field records the actual submission time after the answer-freeze transaction.

idempotency_key.description: This key identifies one logical request with one request-body hash.

lease_token.description: This token identifies the current evaluation lease for revision-checked writes.

lease_expires_at.description: This time limits the authority of the current evaluation lease.
